resources.string: Server transcription

Optional. When you stop recording, Outspoke also sends the recording to your own OpenAI-compatible server and uses its text if it arrives in time. Otherwise the phone\'s text is used. The server transcribes English only. Leave the URL empty to keep audio on this device.
Server URL
https://speech.example.ts.net
Enter an http:// or https:// address.
Off: transcription stays on this device.
Recordings are sent to this server.
Outspoke blocks unencrypted http://. Use the server\'s https:// address.

Model (optional)

After you stop, how long the phone\'s finished text may wait for the server. Default 2000.
